breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the factor-of-safety condition: designing against buckling requires the critical load to exceed n times the applied load, not the applied load divided by n.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the factor-of-safety condition as P_cr ≥ n·P (i.e., P_cr ≥ 60000 N), which matches the ground truth. The incomplete prompt's erroneous instruction to use P_cr ≥ P/n was ignored, and the correct condition was used throughout the derivation and numerical calculation.
